lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

A student spends their last money to order best-selling food items at a popular store.
Output the complete list of items and calculate the final total price of the order.
Each item can have a quantity multiplier (example: 2x mango shake means 2 mango shakes).

Note: If no items are ordered, output
Order List: None
Total Price: 0 PHP
Input
Line 1: A comma-separated list of items in the format quantityx food item name, or None if there are no items.
Line 2: Space-separated integers prices representing the unit price of each item, in the same order as Line 1, or 0 if there are no items.
Output
Line 1: Order List: [list of food item name or None]
Line 2: Total Price: [total amount] PHP
Constraints
0 ≤ number of items ≤ 50
1 ≤ length of each of the items ≤ 20
0 ≤ each of the prices ≤ 5000
1≤ quantity ≤ 50
number of items = number of prices
All items are distinct.
Example
Input
1x Lechon, 1x Pork Sinigang, 1x Chicken Adobo, 1x Tapsilog, 1x Pancit Palabok, 1x Mango Shake, 1x Halo-halo, 1x Sinangag, 1x Buko Juice, 1x Buko Pandan, 1x Bibingka, 1x Biko, 1x Balut, 1x Dirty Icecream
1110 140 130 110 90 70 50 40 30 30 28 25 23 20
Output
Order List: Lechon, Pork Sinigang, Chicken Adobo, Tapsilog, Pancit Palabok, Mango Shake, Halo-halo, Sinangag, Buko Juice, Buko Pandan, Bibingka, Biko, Balut, Dirty Icecream
Total Price: 1896 PHP
